correctness.rationale: For a proposed tournament period-two pair x,y, summing strict voting inequalities over changed 1-to-0 set A and 0-to-1 set B yields e(A,B)+e(B,A)-e(A,A)-e(B,B)>=|A|+|B|, but tournament arc counts make the left side (|A|+|B|-(|A|-|B|)^2)/2, impossible. For a regular tournament each class in a mixed fixed state would require at least 2ceil(k/2)+1 vertices, exceeding 2k+1 in total. The special Paley prime cases are finite, explicitly all 2^3+2^7+2^11+2^19=526472 labelled states. Separately written Python functional-graph enumeration from quadratic-residue adjacency recovered orbit counts p3 {1:2,3:2}, p7 {1:2,7:6}, p11 {1:2}, p19 {1:2,4:342,19:18}, and sharp entry depths 0,3,5,7. Independently generated affine-square/complement/temporal group orbit closures at p19 give exactly the four classes (0,period1,size2), (511,period19,size342), (3543,period4,size684), (5751,period4,size684). The finite exhaustive verification is not extrapolated to other primes.
